title: Sea Turtle Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, each level is crafted with thoughtful luxury—from the chef’s dream kitchen with Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances to multiple wet bars, stylish bunk rooms, and plush king suites with spa-worthy bathrooms. The third-floor balcony is a standout, offering a front-row seat to Gulf sunsets beside the glow of a fire pit. With two laundry rooms, elevator access, and spaces designed for both lively gatherings and peaceful retreats, this home offers effortless comfort. Whether it’s a poolside lunch, sunset cocktails on the terrace, or mornings on the sand, every moment here is curated for connection, joy, and unforgettable coastal memories. Tucked away in a gated enclave of Seagrove Beach, this three-story luxury retreat captures the best of 30A living with sweeping Gulf views, vibrant designer interiors, and unmatched outdoor amenities. With seven spacious bedrooms, seven full and two half bathrooms, and accommodations for up to 28 guests, it’s the ultimate getaway for large families or group vacations. Private beach access is just steps away, while a private plunge pool, al fresco dining area, and balcony fire pit offer elevated ways to unwind and enjoy the coast. A 6-seater golf cart and six adult bikes make exploring the area easy and fun.
